name: cadenceux
description: Claude skills for Claris FileMaker developers from CadenceUX: FileMaker Pro reference, scripting patterns, plug-in references and FileMaker Server operations, built to work with the Claris Agentic Development Toolkit (ADT).

plugins.name: claris-filemaker-pro
plugins.description: FileMaker Pro reference: every calculation function and script step with exact syntax, return types, versions and seven-product platform support, plus the Data API, OData, SQL, WebDirect and FileMaker Go. Works with the Claris Agentic Development Toolkit (ADT) when it's installed.

plugins.name: fmp-dev-design-patterns
plugins.description: Scripting conventions and design patterns for Claris FileMaker: boilerplate, error handling, JSON parameters, transactions, AI steps, naming and anti-patterns, with scripts written into the file through the Claris Agentic Development Toolkit (ADT).

plugins.name: fmp-dev-orchestrator
plugins.description: Routes FileMaker work to the CadenceUX skill or Claris ADT tool that owns it, and checks that the stack is current: skills, ADT, FileMaker Pro and the ADT project's packages.

plugins.name: cadenceux-fms-docker-setup
plugins.description: Installs, upgrades and certifies Claris FileMaker Server in Docker on macOS, from Claris's arm64 Ubuntu build, with snapshot-based upgrades and rollback.

plugins.name: cadenceux-ottofms-docker-setup
plugins.description: Installs and activates OttoFMS on a Docker-hosted FileMaker Server: install, service start, Nginx /otto/ access, container commit and licence activation.

plugins.name: monkeybread-mbs-plugin
plugins.description: Reference for the MBS FileMaker Plugin from Monkeybread Software: every documented function with signature, parameters, platform support, licensing status and readable script examples, built from the vendor's documentation.

plugins.name: goya-be-plugin
plugins.description: Reference for the free, open-source BaseElements FileMaker plug-in by Goya: every BE_ function and constant with signatures, platform support, version history and deprecations.

plugins.name: beezwax-bbox-plugin
plugins.description: Reference for the free bBox FileMaker plug-in by Beezwax Datatools: shell, AppleScript, Python, Node, cURL, DuckDB/SQLite, jq, images, pasteboard and web viewer functions, with mode flags and error handling.

plugins.name: cadenceux-skill-creator
plugins.description: Builds, updates and reviews Claude skills to Anthropic's skill authoring best practices: evals first, progressive disclosure, a validator script, Haiku/Sonnet/Opus testing, and packaging for GitHub, plugin marketplaces and Claude.ai.

plugins.name: cadenceux-github
plugins.description: Shares a FileMaker developer's Claude skill on GitHub: creating the account, scrubbing client material, the plugin and marketplace files, release .zip and .skill archives built from a tag, updates, and reviewing published skills for unreleased changes.
